description: Auto-generate a storyboard from either script OR situationen (mutually exclusive). An LLM splits script into scenes; situationen bypasses that LLM entirely and generates exactly one frame per entry, ignoring max_scenes. situationen requires figur_id of an existing character sheet with a reference image: every frame uses that character on seedream_5_pro, without creating a new sheet. format selects 16:9 (default) or 9:16 for every model. bewegung_en is saved in each frame’s metadata for later animation. COSTS CREDITS — every scene is one generated image, charged up front for the number of scenes the script is split into (at most max_scenes). Ask the human before running it. CHARACTERS ARE NOT GUESSED: every character who appears in more than one frame first gets a reference image (an existing project character with a reference is reused for free; a new one is created and its reference sheet is charged separately as character_sheet_generate), and every frame showing such a character is generated WITH those references on seedream_5_pro instead of `model`. Frames without a recurring character use `model`. The answer lists `figuren` (name, status, scenes), `figuren_kosten_geschaetzt` and `kosten_je_bild`; prices per model come from lab_list_models. If a reference cannot be made, the frames that need it fail and are refunded — they are never generated without it. The scene split is SYNCHRONOUS and can take up to ~55s and then time out (504) for long scripts; run it in the app if so. The answer lists the new image ids; the frames themselves render in the background as pending images — poll them with lab_job_status (type 'image').

creativity.description: Krea 2 creativity setting; ignored by flux_pro. Default medium.

figur_id.description: Existing character-sheet id with a reference image; required for situationen, only used with situationen

figuren_raten.description: Opt-out, off by default: true skips the character references and lets the image model invent every character from the text — a different face in every frame. Only set it when the human explicitly asks for that; it is recorded on every frame (figuren_geraten).

format.description: Frame aspect ratio for every model, default 16:9

max_scenes.description: Upper limit for the number of scenes, and therefore images charged. Backend default when omitted.

model.description: Image model for the frames. Default krea_2_medium. Prices per model: lab_list_models.

script.description: Screenplay or scene description; provide either script or situationen. The backend splits script into scenes; each scene becomes one image.

situationen.description: Independent situations, each exactly one frame. Requires figur_id; excludes script and figuren_raten.

bewegung_en.description: English motion prompt with a strong movement verb

bild_en.description: English still prompt: one moment, one action

style_reference_url.description: Shared moodboard image applied to ALL frames for one consistent look. Used by Krea 2 and by the Seedream character-reference path (one additional reference, included in pricing). Must be an asset of this project or an absolute URL — anything else is refused before credits are spent.
